name: KromiumDownloadProgress
declaration:

    val bytesRead: Long,
    val totalBytes: Long?,
    val fraction: Float
)

constructors.signature: KromiumDownloadProgress(bytesRead: Long, totalBytes: Long?, fraction: Float)

parameters.description: Fraction of download completed from 0.0f to 1.0f.
